lengthInseam.d: Controls the total length of the shorts at the inseam, relative to the total inseam measurement

outseamShorter.d: Cuts the outseam shorter to create an angle at the hem

pocketDepth.d: How far below the waist the pockets should end. Measure from your waist to where your fingertips fall on your side.

pocketOpeningDepth.d: How deep the pocket openings should be. They can't be shallower than the necessary front opening.

pocketBottomCurve.d: Adjusts the curve of the bottom of the pocket opening

pocketCurveControl.d: Adjust the curve of the bottom of the pocket bag

pocketFacingUnderlap.d: How far the pocket bag extends horizontally beyond the pocket opening, on the inside of the shorts.

outseamAngle.d: How far to rotate the outseam

inseamAngle.d: How far to rotate the inseam

backPocketDepth.d: The depth (vertical) of the back pocket

backPocketWidth.d: The width of the back pocket

backPocketTopHemAllowance.d: How much extra fabric to fold over at the top of the back pocket

frontPanelPercentage.d: How wide to draft the opening of the front pocket

beltLoops.d: Controls the amount of belt loops

yokeAngle.d: How far the yoke should be curved to create butt shaping

yokeDepth.d: How deep the yoke should be at the center back

waistbandCurve.d: Controls how curved the waistband is, if it's not determined automatically

waistbandAngleAutomatic.d: How to determine the waistband angle

flyCurve.d: Controls the curvature of the fly J-seam

flyLength.d: Controls the length of the fly

flyWidth.d: Controls how far the J-seam of offset from the fly edge

hemExtraSeamAllowance.d: How much space to leave at the bottoms of the legs for the hem, as a percentage of the seam allowance elsewhere

yokeRecoveryShift.d: Tweak this if the corners at the top of the yoke are too far from right angles
